  • {{:Fright Forged Helm}}
== Checklist == {{CheckboxList}} * [[Zombie Skin]] (dropped by various zombies) * [[Embalming Dust]] (dropped by mummies and zombies in [[South Ro]]) * [[Charred Bone Chips]] (from a skeleton named [[Obretl]] in South Ro) * [[Vial of Tunare's Breath]] (from a druid named [[Kalayia Woodwhisper]] in [[Lesser Faydark]]) {{End}} == Walkthrough == ''(continued from the [[Initiate Symbol of Cazic Thule]] quest)'' You say, 'What duties?' : Sern Adolia says, 'The primary duties of this temple are to spread terror, fright, and dread as a symbol of your devotion to our lord Cazic Thule. We are currently researching a means of summoning avatars of Fright, Terror and Dread, the primary minions of The Faceless in his home plane. Will you [assist me in summoning] the avatar of Fright?' You say, 'I will assist you in summoning him' : Sern Adolia says, 'In order to summon the avatar of Fright. I require some special components for the ritual. Fetch me the skin of a zombie, the dust used in the process of mummification, [charred bone chips], and a [vial of Tunare's Breath].' You say, 'Tell me about the charred bone chips' : Sern Adolia says, 'Some time ago a necromancer by the name of Obretl was sent to slay Rathmana Allin and his abomination of an adopted son, Ortallius. Obretl failed in his task and now haunts a small ruin in the desert of Ro cursed by Solusek to wallow in his failure in the form of a burning skeleton. Slay Obretl to free him from his pathetic existence and gather his charred remains.' You say, 'And tell me about the rancid vial of Tunare's Breath' : Sern Adolia says, 'Tunare's Breath is a life-giving potion created by the Fier'Dal Soldiers of Tunare. Seek out the druid Kalayia who is known to wander the Faydarks in search of reagents for potions. Procure from her a vial of Tunare's Breath. Shed her blood if need be.' '''Turn in the items''' : Sern Adolia says, 'Excellent work, young apostle of Fright. Our chanters have successfully summoned the avatar. Hurry and hand him this mundane helm so that he may forge it into a valuable symbol of your devotion to the principles of Fear!'
* Your faction standing with [[Heretics]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Deepwater Knights]] got worse. * Your faction standing with [[Gate Callers]] got worse. * Your faction standing with [[Craftkeepers]] got worse. * Your faction standing with [[Crimson Hands]] got worse.
{{exp}} You receive a [[Mundane Helm]]. Avatar of Fright shouts, Grrrraaaaarrrrrg!! The stench of fear permeates the walls of this city! I will forge one item for the faithful of our Lord Cazic-Thule!! Make haste! My time here is short! [[File:npc_avatar_of_fright.png|frame|Avatar of Fright]] '''Turn around and go out the right door, cross the hall and you'll find the [[Avatar of Fright]]. Give him the [[Mundane Helm]].''' : Avatar of Fright says, 'I grant you the Fright Forged Helm. Wear it in honor of your devotion to our Lord Cazic-Thule!!'
* Your faction standing with [[Heretics]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Deepwater Knights]] got worse. * Your faction standing with [[Gate Callers]] got worse. * Your faction standing with [[Craftkeepers]] got worse. * Your faction standing with [[Crimson Hands]] got worse.
{{exp}} == Note ==
  • This Quest may be multiquested, need confirmation of this.
  • [[Kalayia Woodwhisper]] is an incredibly rare spawn on live, but may be more common here. Her page includes a map of her location. She's a level 22(ish) druid and has no faction hits.
  • [[Obretl]] is a level 22(ish) skeleton necro who is a rare spawn in the mostly-buried tower in South Ro. While killing placeholders you'll likely get the embalming dust and zombie skin.
